name: Resterm Local API Client
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source terminal API client for HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket and SSE; local .http/.rest request files, scripted assertions, mocks and CI runner, with no software usage quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Runs on the user's own machine or CI runner; network, target API, tunnels and CI infrastructure may incur separate costs. No hosted API testing capacity is included; secure request files and credentials before committing them.
